<color=#FFE017>Experience:</color>

Experience points allow your characters to gain levels. When battles are won or quests are completed, you are awarded Experience Points.
When these points are high enough, your experience bar will be full and you will gain a level. The experience bar will then reset and you will regain all missing Health and Mana.

For more specific information, look at the Level tooltip.

<color=#FFE017>经验：</color>

经验值让角色得以升级。赢得战斗或完成任务时，你会获得经验值。
当经验值足够高时，经验条会填满，你将提升一级。随后经验条重置，你也会回复全部失去的生命与法力。

如需更具体的信息，请查看「等级」提示。

lv0#22399/tooltipNote
<color=#FFE017>To Hit:</color>

Hit attempts begin with a random roll of 1-20.
Your ToHit value is then added to that roll along with any Lore Boost you may have from learning about that type of monster.

Your ToHit roll is then matched against a defenders Dodge roll. If you match or beat their value then you have scored a hit.

ToHit is increased by 10% if you have not moved on your turn.
<color=#FFE017>命中：</color>

命中以 1-20 的随机掷骰开始。
随后将你的命中值，以及你因了解该类怪物而获得的学识加成，加到掷值上。

再用你的命中掷值对抗防御者的闪避掷值。若达到或超过对方的数值，即命中。

若你的回合中未移动，命中提高 10%。

lv0#24411/tooltipNote
<color=#FFE017>Leveling:</color>

Levels are how far your character has progressed. When battles are won or quests are completed, you are awarded Experience Points.
When these points are high enough, your experience bar will be full and you will gain a level. The experience bar will then reset and you will regain all missing Health and Mana.
When you level up you also gain:
+ Skill Points - These can be aded in the Skills menu to raise skill levels.
<color=#FFBF00>+ Ability Points </color>- These can be used to purchase new Abilities under the Abilities menu.
Ability Points are awarded every 5 levels and are represented by an orange mark near your portrait.
<color=#00BFFF>+ Trait Points </color>- These can be used to purchase new Traits under the Traits menu.
Trait Points are awarded every 3 levels and are represented by a blue mark near your portrait.
New traits become availble to choose when you learn enough about a monster through Monster Lore.
<color=#F50002>+ Max Health </color> - Health points gained are equal to your Resistance points over 10 plus half your Strength points over 10.
<color=#005BF5>+ Max Mana </color> -  Mana points gained are equal to your Mind points over 10 plus half your Spirit points over 10.
<color=#FFE017>升级：</color>

等级代表你角色的成长程度。赢得战斗或完成任务时，你会获得经验值。
当经验值足够高时，经验条会填满，你将提升一级。随后经验条重置，你也会回复全部失去的生命与法力。
升级时你还会获得：
+ 技能点——可在技能菜单中投入，以提升技能等级。
<color=#FFBF00>+ 能力点 </color>——可在能力菜单中购买新能力。
能力点每 5 级发放一次，以你头像旁的橙色标记表示。
<color=#00BFFF>+ 特质点 </color>——可在特质菜单中购买新特质。
特质点每 3 级发放一次，以你头像旁的蓝色标记表示。
当你通过「怪物学识」对某种怪物了解得足够多时，即可选择新的特质。
<color=#F50002>+ 最大生命 </color>——获得的生命点数等于你的抗性点数除以 10，加上力量点数的一半除以 10。
<color=#005BF5>+ 最大法力 </color>——获得的法力点数等于你的心智点数除以 10，加上精神点数的一半除以 10。

+ Disarm
+ Identify
+ Barter

<color=#FFE017>How Stats work:</color>

Stats work as multipliers, with 10 being the baseline. Every Stat value above or below that changes your modifier by 10%. In this regard, a single point increase may not look like much, but actually represents an increase that scales as you grow more powerful.

<color=#FFE017>心智：</color>
+ 抵抗恐惧
+ 抗心智
+ 法力值（主要）
+ 技能点
+ 更快学会技能、能力与法术
+ 决定最高法术层级（若高于 SPI）

<color=#00BFBF>技能：</color>
+ 警觉
+ 怪物学识
+ 生存
+ 卸除武器
+ 鉴定
+ 议价

<color=#FFE017>属性如何生效：</color>

属性以倍率方式生效，基准值为 10。每高出或低于 10 一点，修正值就变化 10%。因此，单点提升看似不多，实际上会随着你的成长带来越来越大的增益。

<color=#FFE017>Defense:</color>

Defense is a 50/50 chance to reduce physical damage of any type, including damage that ignores armor.

Defense is calculated after your armor reduces incoming damage and acts as a secondary defense.

<color=#FFE017>防御：</color>

<color=#FFE017>Dodge:</color>

Dodge is an attempt to ignore an attack entirely, so that no damage calculation is made. Some effects require a hit, and Dodge is the only way to avoid them.
Dodge attempts begin with a random roll of 1-20.

Your Dodge value is then added to that roll and compared to the attackers ToHit value.
If you beat the ToHit value you have successfully dodged.

<color=#FFE017>闪避：</color>

闪避是尝试完全无视一次攻击，使伤害计算根本不会发生。某些效果必须先命中才能生效，而闪避是避开它们的唯一办法。
闪避以 1-20 的随机掷骰开始。

随后将你的闪避值加到掷值上，与攻击者的命中值比较。
若你超过对方的命中值，闪避成功。
